hack.root_cause: Native token self-swap price inflation — tokenIn/tokenOut identity bypass
hack.description: MonoX lost $31.4M when an attacker exploited a missing check in its swap contract that allowed the same token to be used as both input and output, inflating MONO's price to purchase the entire protocol's liquidity.
